name: SaladStop!
src: SaladStop! Singapore website nutrition calculator (the JSON files its menu pages load), per item as served; Create-Your-Own dressings and toppings per portion. Calories as published. No allergens: SaladStop's tags leave out egg, soy and sesame. Not halal: bacon bits are pork. Left out 1 row(s) whose figures don't add up: Granola (131 kcal vs 405 from macros). Also left out 14 drinks with no fat figure or plain water (cold-pressed juices, immunity shots, still and sparkling water).
